original: WPRPLACE (Icelandic pronunciation: [ˈatnarˌfjœrðʏr̥] ) is a large fjord in the Westfjords region of Iceland. "Arnar" is the genitive case of "Örn" ([ˈœtn̥]), the name of the first settler of the fjord.
